notes.title: 8/24/2018 Patch
notes.content:
Buffs/Nerfs:

Revolver

- Reload decreased to .5 seconds from 2 seconds

- Increased fire rate from 120 rpm to 720 rpm

Impeder

- Clip size reduced to 7 from 10

- Damage decreased from 1 to .5 

- Fire rate decreased from 180 rpm to 120 rpm

Mini Gun

- Damage decreased from .25 to .15

Medkit

- Increased cast time from 2 seconds to 3 seconds


Bug Fixes:

- Fixed Medkit refund bug

- Fixed Medkit multiple uses at once bug

- Changed white wall colors to an off white color to make hud easier to read
